messages:
morgan: Quick ping 1: the code block in /platform/guide shows an example `curl -X GET https://short.redwood/assets/logo.svg` which 403s when copied into demos. Anyone owning that page?

anya: Thanks for flagging. Shortlinks are ephemeral after credential rotations. Which exact section is it in?

morgan: Under 'Deploy checklist' -> 'Verify static assets'. It's the second snippet. Causing problems in the onboarding workshop.

phil: I can take this. Minimal fix: replace the shortlink with the mapped asset path `/assets/docs/platform/logo.svg` and add a parenthetical: "(CDN-backed; no presigned URL)".

anya: Also suggest adding a tiny docs-lint rule that fails if `short.redwood` appears in codeblocks. We keep hitting this.

phil: Agree. I'll make two commits: 1) quick PR swapping the link, 2) open an issue for lint rule and add a follow-up ticket in the docs board.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4512 title: "docs(platform): replace ephemeral shortlink in deploy checklist" assignee: phil.

morgan: Can someone from eng-platform glance at the staging preview after merge? Want to confirm the codeblock copy behavior is preserved.

phil: @anya can you review? Low-risk but preview check appreciated.

anya: Reviewing now. If CI passes I'll merge and run a quick staging preview.

docs-bot: PR merged by anya 1: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4512 1 deployed to staging.

phil: Verified staging preview; snippet copies cleanly and image renders. Created issue #1203 for lint rule. Closing the loop. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
